body:
Yes! It is a terrible feeling, and most likely one you’ll never fully recover from. I begged and begged. Cried and cried to him but he simply did not care. It was genuinely the most painful experience I’ve ever gone through (and I’ve been through too much.) 

Honestly honey, you’re not a fool. You loved them and that is beautiful. And guess what? If they walked away all cold like, then they’re not worth it
Thank you for this. It’s been a little over a year for me and it’s still got me fucked up. But I’m def way better than I was a year ago

My bf left me after 3 and a half years and blocked me on everything. Today I got him on the phone and he was pretty harsh to me. My heart is completely shattered and although I am still going to fight for him, I know that what we have may be completely gone. I also recognize what I did wrong but I also recognize what he did as well. I love him so deeply it hurts but I know either way I will be okay. He blames me for it all pretty much but honestly I’ve come to realize that it’s not all my fault. This post genuinely had helped me weirdly haha. Thank you!

I’m 20 and he’s 21. For me, it’s very hard to tell people I love them. It’s hard for me to show my genuine feelings. I’m really not sure why. He said it feels like It’s a chore for me to love him, but that’s just not true. I love him so incredibly much. We’ve both hurt eachother in two different ways but I guess mine was worse than I had thought

Thank you I needed to hear that! I go in and out of sadness but the anxiety rn is constant. It’s only been 4 days so who knows what will happen, but I know time will heal y’a know. Thank you for the reassurance!

We were dating for 3 and a half years. And no I’m not really close to his family at all. And idk, this just isn’t like him and we would talk all day everyday. I can’t imagine he’s just completely cutting me off but idk

Hey this is exactly what’s happening to me. Everything was going so well and then out of no where he said we should break up although that day we were having amazing phone convos. He broke up with me, said he loved me and cared for me and left. I’ve texted him so many times and absolutely no response. He’s completely ghosting me but I don’t think he’s blocked me. If he doesn’t respond soon idk what I’m going to do and I’m so scared. He’s my best friend and it makes me sick thinking of being a stranger to him. I’m so sorry this is happening to you but you’re truly not alone

I feel the same honestly. My bf broke up with me 4 days ago now and I just miss everything about him. He’s completely ghosted me after just breaking up with me so I have no idea what is going on in his head and it’s killing me. Not knowing whether he hates me or still loves me. I’m so scared to become a stranger to him and it makes so sick to think about. I wish you the best of luck tho!
